exclusions.source_text: Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) or alanine aminotransferase (ALT) \>3 × upper limit of normal (ULN) with concurrent total bilirubin (TBIL) \>2 × ULN
exclusions.threshold: AST or ALT >3 x ULN with TBIL >2 x ULN

exclusions.source_text: Isolated TBIL \>2 × ULN (excluding patients with Gilbert's syndrome)
Alkaline phosphatase (ALP) \>2 x ULN with gamma-glutamyl transferase (GGT) \>2 x ULN
exclusions.threshold: ALP >2 x ULN with GGT >2 x ULN
